Unexplainable host Noam Hassenfeld wasn’t expecting to get into a fight over the color of a tennis ball… and yet, Noam couldn’t even get a consensus from this week’s guest, neuroscientist and color expert Bevil Conway. This week’s show is all about how we can see the same color and take away something totally different. 

What color do you think a tennis ball is? Let us know in the comments and watch Unexplainable on Netflix.
